title: The Solar System and Galaxy
seo_title: Grade 6 Science: The Solar System and Galaxy Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: The solar system is part of the Milky Way, which is one of billions of galaxies: the Sun, planets and other bodies, the scale of the solar system, and stars and galaxies. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 6, Earth and Space Science)
meta_desc: Free Grade 6 science worksheets (BC): the Sun and planets, distances and scale, orbits and years, stars, the Milky Way and light years. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: The Sun is one star in the Milky Way galaxy.
key_sub: Planets orbit the Sun; the Moon orbits Earth.
body_html:
How to think about it

The solar system is the Sun and everything that orbits it: eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids and comets. The inner planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) are rocky; the outer planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) are gas and ice giants.

The Sun is a star, one of hundreds of billions in the Milky Way galaxy. Distances in space are so large that we measure them in light years, the distance light travels in one year.

Example

Which planet is closest to the Sun?

The smallest inner planet

Answer: Mercury

Example

What is a light year a unit of?

It is not time.

Answer: distance

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a light year is a unit of time.
  • Thinking the Sun is the biggest star in the galaxy.
  • Thinking the planets are close together in models drawn to fit a page.

items.q: Arcturus is about 37 light years away. How long does its light take to reach us?
items.e: A light year is the distance light travels in one year, so the light takes 37 years.

items.q: Light from the sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. Light from Arcturus takes 37 years. Why does the sun look so much brighter?

items.e: The sun is about 8 light-minutes away; Arcturus is 37 light-years away. Distance makes the difference.
